metadata.title: [FIX][API]: Accept parameterized MIME types in resource validation
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANA.R <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>

closes #3051 
Implemented full fix for parameterized MIME handling in validation logic: accepts valid MIME parameters and still rejects malformed/unsafe formats in validators.py.

Updated admin UX guidance for UI resources so MIME helper text is contextual (shown for ui:// resource flows on MIME focus) in admin.html and admin.js.

Added and refined unit coverage for MIME validation in test_validators_advanced.py.

Added and refined e2e coverage for admin resource create/list persistence of parameterized MIME values in test_admin_apis.py.

Removed profile-specific example bias from docs/tests and generalized cases to avoid single hardcoded MIME dependencies.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review — LGTM

Rebased onto main, resolved 2 merge conflicts in `admin.html` (kept main's `px-3 py-2` padding with PR's `id`/`aria-describedby` accessibility attributes), and fixed 3 flake8 lint errors.

### Maintainer changes (2 commits)

1. **`style: collapse MIME regex to single line per black formatting`** — black (line-length 200) wants the `_MIME_TYPE_RE` on a single line.
2. **`fix: resolve flake8 DUO138 and DAR401 lint errors`** — added `# noqa: DUO138` (false positive: no ReDoS risk since inner groups require literal `;` and `=` delimiters); added missing `ImportError` to `Raises` docstrings in `MCPChatService.initialize()` and `reload_tools()`.

### Code review findings

**Regex** — Correct RFC 2045 parameter syntax. Tested against edge cases: multiple params, quoted values, missing `=value`, trailing semicolons, unclosed quotes — all behave correctly. No ReDoS risk (no ambiguous quantifier nesting; each parameter iteration must consume a literal `;`).

**Logic** — `base_type = value.split(";", 1)[0].strip()` correctly extracts the base type before allow-list check. Evil parameterized types (`application/evil; charset=utf-8`) are properly rejected. Vendor (`x-`) and suffix (`+`) fallbacks still operate on `base_type` only.

**Security** — Quoted param values (`"[^"\r\n]*"`) allow `<`/`>` per RFC, but all rendering paths use `document.createTextNode()` (not `innerHTML`) and Jinja2 auto-escaping — no XSS risk.

**Admin UI** — `bindMcpAppMimeHelper()` is clean: idempotent binding guard via `dataset.mcpAppMimeHelperBound`, proper `focus`/`blur` event handling, correct `aria-describedby` accessibility.

**Tests** — Full differential coverage: unit tests cover valid parameterized types, generated invalid formats from all allowed types, and non-whitelisted base types with params. E2E test verifies create + list persistence of 3 parameterized MIME values. Doctests updated and passing.
